paper_title: Search for oscillations of fundamental constants using molecular spectroscopy
notes: Paper constrains coupling of oscillating UDM field to quarks/gluons (QCD sector), with main exclusion plot (Fig 3) showing combination Q_N·d = 0.999 d_gs + 0.092 d_mhat + ... vs f_phi (Compton frequency, 10 Hz - 10^8 Hz, i.e. ~4e-14 to 4e-7 eV). This is a scalar coupling to nucleon mass (ScalarNucleon hint plausible). Also presents constraints on d_alpha (ScalarPhoton) and d_me (ScalarElectron) in Figs 4 and 5. Multiple coupling types present, lowering confidence. No numerical tables of exclusion values are provided in the extractable text — data only in plots (Figs 2-5) which are not numerically readable here. Galactic halo density 0.3 GeV/cm^3 used (also solar halo 10^5 x and Earth halo scenarios). 95% CL. No extractable (mass, coupling) pairs. | Vision: This plot is the d_me (ScalarElectron) exclusion plot, NOT ScalarNucleon as hinted. The y-axis is d_{m_e}. The lowest boundary at small mass comes from the Be-Al/Be-Ti equivalence-principle solid lines (~1e-3 to ~1), but the steeply rising MICROSCOPE curve (cyan) defines the dominant lower boundary that rapidly increases with mass. I traced the cyan MICROSCOPE 'only d_me != 0' curve which forms the lowest constraint at very low mass and rises sharply. Coupling type identified as ScalarElectron (d_me), which differs from the ScalarNucleon hint; confidence lowered accordingly. | Calibration: Spot-check calibration: verify/stage2 ratio=66.7x
